title: Treaty of Stolbovo
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Stolbovo", at revision 1375161851, opens: "The Treaty of Stolbovo was a peace treaty that ended the Ingrian War, which had been fought between the Swedish Empire and the Russian Tsardom between 1610 and 1617." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q928848, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1617 peace treaty that ended the Ingrian War between the Swedish and the Russian Empires". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
